title: Relay Management
description: Configure and manage Nostr relays for optimal connectivity

steps.title: Relay Basics
steps.description: Relays are servers that store and forward Nostr events. You need at least 2 for redundancy.

steps.title: Add Recommended Relays
steps.description: Click 'Add Recommended' to add popular public relays

steps.title: Relay Health
steps.description: Monitor latency, success rate, and supported NIPs. Red indicators mean issues.

steps.title: Test Relay
steps.description: Click the test icon next to any relay to verify connectivity

steps.title: Read/Write Relays
steps.description: Configure separate read and write relay lists. Write relays should be trusted; read relays can be many.
